exposure: Laparoscopic neurolysis for endometriosis infiltrating pelvic nerves
Excision of endometriosis of pelvic nerves
cohort: The study included 21 patients diagnosed with endometriosis infiltrating pelvic nerves who underwent laparoscopic neurolysis for chronic pain at an Endometriosis referral center.
finding: Laparoscopic neurolysis and excision of endometriosis of pelvic nerves resulted in significant improvement of chronic pain, a decrease in analgesic consumption, and improved quality of life for a majority of patients.
